title: The Letter C — C is for Creation
objective: Students will learn the letter C and its sound using the Bible word Creation.
content: Today we learn the letter C! The letter C makes the sound 'kuh' like in the word Creation. Can you say 'kuh'?
Creation means everything God made! God created the sky, the land, the oceans, the animals, and people. God's creation is beautiful!
C is also in the words Cat, Cloud, and Cup. Let's practice the 'kuh' sound together. C-C-Creation!
activity: Trace the letter C with your finger. Draw your favorite part of God's creation. Find things that start with C.
discussion: What sound does the letter C make?
What is your favorite thing God created?
